concerns.text: Task T009 (`src/data/materials.py`) imports `src/constants/material_lattice.yaml`, which is created by Task T010. The producer (T010) must precede the consumer (T009) to avoid import errors.

Task T011 (`src/data_ingestion/fetch_materials_cloud.py`) reads and updates `state/dataset_registry.json` managed by Task T013, but T013 is listed after T011. The registry creation (T013) must occur before any fetch script that writes to it.
Task T012 (`src/data_ingestion/fetch_zenodo.py`) also depends on the `dataset_registry.json` produced by Task T013, yet T013 is scheduled later. Reorder so T013 precedes T011 and T012.
Task T014 (`src/data_ingestion/loader.py`) references the dataset registry for provenance checks; therefore Task T013 must be executed before T014.
